title: Closing sends no invoice and no customer to QuickBooks
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the test location is connected to QuickBooks Online, with Inventory Asset and Cost of Parts mapped on its ShopView Accounts page, and that AccountingHub is not enabled.
  • Have access to the QuickBooks Online company of the test location, so its journal entries can be read.
  • Make sure the General Internal category is mapped to an expense account, account X, at the test location.
  • Make sure Require Review Before Completion is off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer, never sent to QuickBooks before.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in status Complete, with two stock parts picked from inventory: part A, quantity 2 at a cost of $40.00, and part B, quantity 1 at a cost of $25.00, whose Shop supplies amount is $15.00.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Close Work Order in the work order header.
  3. Click Close Work Order in the confirmation.
  4. In QuickBooks Online, search the invoices, sales receipts and payments for work order 1's number.
  5. In QuickBooks Online, search the customers for customer A's name.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The Close confirmation opens.

Step 3:

  • The work order shows the status Closed.

Step 4:

  • No invoice, sales receipt or payment for work order 1 is found, while its journal entries are found (see the next cases).

Step 5:

  • Customer A is not in QuickBooks.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order), story SV-11764 (Story 7, QuickBooks Online sync)

  • S7-R1: “No invoice, sales receipt or payment is sent to QuickBooks for an internal or no-charge work order. The customer is not created in QuickBooks on its account.”
  • S3-R4: “No payment is recorded (not even the $0 payment a $0 invoice writes today) and no "Invoice paid" log entry is written, no customer transaction or receivable is created, no customer portal notification, email or invoice webhook is sent (the work order status webhook of Story 11 is), no invoice is sent to QuickBooks, the internal invoice is never listed in the Open API invoice lists and invoice.created and invoice.paid are never sent for it (both from the core release on, before Story 11), no tax, fee or discount is added, the shop supplies amount is not charged to the customer (it posts as an expense, Story 10), and the customer portal does not list the document (the portal vehicle list still counts a closed internal or no-charge work order for Last Service and Completed, as a service on the unit with $0.00 owed). Close and Reopen are recorded in the work order log as invoice created and reversed are today.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
